clips.title: The story
paras: Brackwell Pumpkin Patch is an overrun farmstead in southeastern Elwynn Forest. Once home to the Brackwell family, the fields and cottage have been thoroughly seized by the Defias Brotherhood as an operational hideout. It serves as a meeting point for rogue conspirators and a staging ground for smuggling stolen gold.

Situated southeast of the Stonefield homestead, the Brackwell farm was once a productive patch of Elwynn farmland. Today, the rightful owners have vanished without a trace, driven out or worse by the rising criminal tide. In their absence, the Defias Brotherhood claimed the farm's sturdy cottage and overgrown fields. The area functions as a safehouse and transfer post, where brigands regroup away from the watchful eyes of Goldshire's patrols. High-profile conspirators like Morgan the Collector use the isolated patch to receive shipments of illicitly gathered gold skimmed from the forest's mines.
